overview: You may think you know all there is to know about the Food That Built America, but there's more to the story. In this new series, The History Channel delves even deeper into the stories behind the ruthless innovators and entrepreneurs featured in the Food That Built America. Spotlighting the rest of the story you didn't know, the series tells the super-charged, bite-sized history of all of the foods you love in 30 minutes or less.
title: The Food That Built America: Snack Sized

overview: Adapted from the novel "Ming Qiang Yi Duo, An Jian Nan Fang" (明枪易躲, 暗恋难防) by Qiao Yao (翘摇). An idol singer who shines brightly on the stage turns out to have the gaming skills of an elementary school student. Meanwhile, a smart and handsome university student immerses in the game, not knowing that his beloved idol is on the other side of the screen. Through interlaced time and space, an online crush turns into a budding love. What will happen between the talented female singer and the top male student?
title: Love Scenery

overview: A police inspector tries to find out who has murdered numerous inmates who could have been released from prison thanks to the cancellation of the controversial Parot doctrine.
title: Parot

overview: High Flyers traces the lives of a group of ordinary kids, sharing their disappointments and triumphs as they discover their collective talents in an extraordinary children's circus. When Luke and Phoebe move to the country, first impressions of their new home aren't encouraging. New school, no friends, in the middle of nowhere — who needs it? But when they discover it has its own circus for kids, the dramas, adventures, relationships and backflips unfold.
title: High Flyers

overview: The new program aims to combine eco-friendly cooking with fun cooking broadcasts. Through Food-vengers, top chefs and cast members will create and present new menus using leftover ingredients to promote zero-waste cooking.
title: Food Avengers

overview: Norwegian barbecue enthusiasts gather at the idyllic Villa Malla in Hurum to compete to become Norway's Grill Champion. Two barbecue tasks are on the menu each episode and two judges judge which couple is allowed to stay and who has to go home.
title: Norges Grillmester

overview: 15 participants start with long legs, pointed elbows and high ambitions. The girls must cope with both difficult challenges and each other, and at the same time be prepared to pack their bags and travel to unknown places at short notice. The winner of Top Model gets the chance to enter a world full of fashion, a lot of work and great experiences.
title: Top Model Norge

overview: Leo is a first-time voter and has learned through eight episodes that everything is politics. Now he will teach you the same thing.
title: Leo tar valget

overview: "Game Change" authors Mark Halperin and John Heilemann host this daily, hour long show, the centerpiece of Bloomberg's new Bloomberg Politics unit. In addition to the latest news of the day, the pair welcomes guests from the top tier of the political spectrum -- House Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi and Gov. Mitt Romney were in the premiere episode -- but politics is just one of the subjects covered on With All Due Respect for entertainment topics are also a regular feature.
title: With All Due Respect

overview: Og nå: Reklame! is a series that documented advertising; showing how deceptive the advertisement industry can be.
title: Og nå: Reklame!

overview: Olsenbanden jr. første kupp is about Olsenbanden's first coup. The story takes place in the 1950s and the gang members are only 12-13 years old. Egon Olsen meets Benny Fransen and Kjell Jensen when he, as a new student at the school, makes his first friends. And it does not take long before they end up in trouble. Egon lives in an orphanage, and each year the orphanage is awarded a large sum of money to celebrate Christmas for. This year, however, the Christmas fund is empty, and Egon suspects that the law firm that looks after the fund has emptied it of money. The Olsen band, led by Egon, starts the hunt for the Christmas fund, and the gang gets into many exciting and fun situations - as the Olsen band is also known for.
title: Olsenbanden jr. første kupp

overview: In this series, Sigrid Bonde Tusvik will help three single Eastfolders to find a new boyfriend. This is a crazy dating carousel over eight weeks with laughter, tears, banter and romances.
title: Sigrid søker selskap

overview: The action takes place in Crow Castle Soria Moria, a forest village. Soria Moria is a guest house, and has been the village's main hall for all these years. During the war, the owner, called "Great Erling", was shot by the Germans here, and his ghost is repeated on Soria Moria. At the beginning of the series, it is his granddaughter Ragnhild who runs the boarding house together with her husband Håvard. But then a German company buys the crow castle, and an ex-policeman Magnus is hired as manager. He has to deal with new and old residents, and all their problems.
title: Soria Moria
Club Friday The Series 12: Ruk Tong Yaeng

overview: Do you ever wonder if your lover, son, nephew or competitor is gay? Wonder no more, because with the right amount of money, you can hire a team of spies who will find the proof for you and avoid any confrontation. Nangfah knows all too well what it's like to date a gay man, after all, she has dated them since grade school and was fooled in every relationship. The last one was the straw that broke the camel's back; she discovered that her then boyfriend was having an affair with her male boss at a gay bar. After the altercation at the gay bar, Nangfah gets fired and blacklisted at all advertising agencies in the city. Desperate for work, she decides to call on an advertisement on Pantip seeking a spy to investigate the sexual orientation of other people.
title: Sai Lub Jub Abb‬

overview: 12 overweight Norwegians start the biggest challenge in their lives: to get rid of their excess life threathening kilograms and change their unhealthy lifestyles.
title: The Biggest Loser Norge

overview: We follow private detective Ole Thune and his team of detectives investigating cases where the police's original investigation has not been sufficient in solving the case.
title: Thune

overview: A world destroyed and returned to nature by a pandemic that affects only adults, a tenacious and courageous girl in search of her little brother, a story of hope and survival.
title: Anna

overview: The Crowded Room follows Danny Sullivan, a man who is arrested following his involvement in a shooting in New York City in 1979. A captivating thriller told through a series of interviews with curious interrogator Rya Goodwin, Danny's life story unfolds, revealing elements of the mysterious past that shaped him, and the twists and turns that will lead him to a life-altering revelation.
title: The Crowded Room

overview: WITS Academy (aka: W.I.T.s Academy) is a spin-off series from Nickelodeon's highly successful series "Every Witch Way". Daniela Nieves, Julia Antonelli, Todd Allen Durkin, and Mia Matthews will reprise their roles as Andi, Jessie, Agamemnon, and Desdemona. It is an american telenovela formatted teen comedy.
title: WITS Academy

overview: Accompanied by a six-part narrative non-fiction audio series, The Line offers a unique perspective on previously untold aspects of the story of US Navy SEAL Eddie Gallagher, who was charged with committing war crimes before ultimately being acquitted on all but one count: for posing in a photo with a corpse. Both series will examine the complicated realities involved with fighting a decades-long war, stripping back the layers surrounding Gallagher's alleged crimes.
title: The Line

overview: Crime Scene Kitchen, an all-new baking competition series is a culinary guessing game in which bakers are tasked with decoding what type of dessert was made, when all that's left are the crumbs, flour trails and a few elusive clues. They must then recreate the recipe for celebrity judges, chef Curtis Stone and cake artist Yolanda Gampp, who will determine how closely their sweet treat matches the missing dessert – and how good it tastes!
title: Crime Scene Kitchen

overview: Two sisters who love each other enough to share their life and breath with each other.
title: Ek Hazaaron Mein Meri Behna Hai

overview: The story of Algeria's past, present and future - from independence to the Arab Spring and beyond. Algeria was under French colonial rule for 132 years. From tears of joy at independence in 1962 to the tragic civil war of the 1990s and the anger that culminated in the Arab Spring, this series provides a unique insight into a country notoriously inaccessible to both journalists and filmmakers. Interviews with key players like Ben Bella, Ait Ahmed and President Abdelaziz Bouteflika, cover 50 years of tragic and powerful history from the Evian Accords of 1962 to the Arab Spring of 2011. This is the story of Algeria's past, present and future. Produced by Flach Film.
title: Algeria: Test of Power

overview: Valen, a young man born on Valentine's Day but has never known love - not even the love of his parents. He meets someone who shows him compassion and tenderness.
title: Love Area

overview: This is the story of three LGBT characters.
title: PaLoMa

overview: Inspired by recent social, cultural and online phenomena, Deadhouse Dark is a boxful of six stories that all take place within the same world – a modern world driven by online connections, constant surveillance, insta-celebrity and an ability to instantly gratify just about any need or desire, no matter how fleeting or dark.
title: Deadhouse Dark

overview: Queer as Folk is a vibrant reimagining of the groundbreaking British series created by Russell T. Davies, exploring a diverse group of friends in New Orleans whose lives are transformed in the aftermath of a tragedy.
title: Queer As Folk

overview: Sugar follows a young woman in New York who balances her neurotic Jewish family with her life as a college sugar baby.
title: Sugar

overview: In March 2012, video game legend Tim Schafer made history with the Double Fine Adventure Kickstarter, a crowdfunding campaign that changed the way games are created and funded forever. For three years, a documentary crew captured the once-secretive process of video game development, chronicling the creation of "Broken Age" from a Kickstarter pitch to a finished game and beyond. Along the way, Schafer and his team at Double Fine persevered through production delays, internal strife, financial crises, looming deadlines, sickness, layoffs, and the weighty expectations of a critical public.
title: Double Fine Adventure!

overview: Løvebakken is a Norwegian comedy program. The program was set up as a political party game with elements of theater sports where it was harassed with current political topics and Norwegian politics in general. There were four panelists divided into two teams. One team was to represent the blue party while the others were to represent the red party, after which they were to present arguments for their views. The main element of the program was the nimble minds of the participants and their desperate attempts to solve tasks they were not prepared for. The program was based on the British program If I Ruled the World
title: Løvebakken

overview: In this documentary series we meet many different girls who had children at a young age. We follow their everyday lives and gain insight into the joys and sorrows they experience throughout their lives as a young mother in Norway.
title: Unge mødre

overview: Series taking a look at famous names who may have had cosmetic surgery.
title: Celebrities: What's Happened to Your Face?

overview: Jo Brand presents a celebration of great sketches of the 1970s, 80s and 90s, with each show featuring archive material and contributions from the writers and performers themselves.
title: Britain's Favourite Comedy

overview: A contemporary take on John Buchan's novel, The 39 Steps centers on Richard Hannay, an ordinary man who became an unwitting pawn in a vast, global conspiracy to reset the world order: 39 Steps that will change the world as we know it, with only Hannay standing in the way.
title: The 39 Steps

overview: In this series, professional makeup artist Lisa Eldridge takes a fascinating journey through the history of hair and makeup. Taking three iconic eras in British history - The Georgians, the Victorians and the 1920s - Lisa explores what the beauty look tells us about the world it grew out of. From the high hair and heavily painted faces of the aristocratic Georgians, to the demure ‘natural' faces of the middle-class Victorian lady, to the red lipped bobbed hair flapper, the series explores key moments in Britain's past.
title: Makeup: A Glamorous History

overview: Nick Groff theorises and investigates the origin of some of the most notorious hauntings in America, redefining our understanding of the paranormal. Death Walker: a person that walks among the dead.
title: Death Walker with Nick Groff

overview: German documentary series about viking women
title: Die Frauen Der Wikinger

overview: The boys are back, hitting the road again for another special edition of A League of Their Own. This time they can't travel abroad so they're going on a staycation. Yes, the road trip is coming home! Once again they'll be joined by familiar faces as they take on a series of challenges across Great Britain.
title: A League of Their Own Road Trip: Loch Ness to London

overview: Joe Show is an Arabic talk show and political satire television program hosted by Egyptian comedian Youssef Hussein and it airs each Thursday. The show deals mainly the events in the Arab world in a comic and cynical manner. The 53-minute television program exploits the media lapses, media biases, and striking paradoxes in the rhetoric of political and conflicting positions; It is reintroduced comically. The show consists of 4 segments; the first three cover current events in Egypt, the fourth looks at the rest of the Arab world.
title: Joe Show

overview: Follow journalist Alexandra Alevêque and meet people living in the coldest, warmest, highest, most humid, and most densely populated cities in the world. Alexandra will experience life in these extreme cities and live in each one long enough to learn about the locals' way of life and gain insight into humankind's incredible capacity to adapt and find solutions to survive.
title: Welcome to My Strange City

overview: The life of a Hollywood couple raising their family in Malibu
title: Movie Stars

overview: 100% Era imagines the post-corona future. How the lives of kids born during the pandemic will look like? What will humanity and teens look like in 2044? Our teenagers living in a more competitive world, where the world no longer needs human hands. For humans, the competition to rise to the top is intensifying. How to secretly love children in the era when schools disappeared and contactless. Hee Jae and Shi Dae attend the same top rank education academy. It focuses on training kids to score 100% on tests, while kids who score below 90% get expelled. In such an environment, Shi Dae and Hee Jae spend their teenage years and grow together.
title: 100% Era

overview: A reality talent show, showcasing Nigeria's strongest undiscovered vocalists as they compete for an ultimate prize with the help of some established superstar coaches.
title: The Voice Nigeria

overview: The singer-songwriter Mat is facing a mental crash. Actually he is sufficiently successful, has a steady relationship, is not unhappy with his life. There he meets Monika: She is "efficient, organized" and in the process of earning a promotion - Monika is a "moderate depression", namely Mats. Her current assignment to make life difficult for Mat becomes unusual when he begins to see his depression: That has never happened to Monika and that is not intended! That's supposed to happen to schizophrenia, but not to depression like you. Can it cost her promotion? For his part, Mat does what one should do when seeing non-existent people: he tries to get rid of these hallucinations as quickly as possible.
title: The Mopes

overview: Set in Villa Rauzán, the telenovela centers onSebastián de Mendoza, a mysterious man known for seducing women and then leaving them. He's also suffering from catalepsy, a disease that he has inherited from his father. He meets Soledad de Santiño, a young woman belonging to a prestigious family, and falls in love with her. But one day before his wedding with Soledad, he suffers a cataleptic attack and is buried alive.
title: Rauzán

overview: Norwegian humor series with sketches, parodies, musical performances and madness from top shelf. Robert Stoltenberg, Herborg Kråkevik, Bjarte Tjøstheim, Live Nelvik, Steinjo, Vidar Magnussen and Kristin Grue entertains on Saturday evenings.
title: Underholdningsavdelingen

overview: A game show where each week two new people come to the show. They then have to guess on different statistics about the Norwegian people.
title: 9 av 10 Nordmenn

overview: The Amazing Race Norge is modeled after the US Series, with a group of people traveling all over the world in teams of two, aiming to win a cash price at the end.
title: The Amazing Race Norge

overview: Hvaler is the story of 29-year-old Maria Blix, a young and newly trained psychologist full of ambition. She is in the midst of fierce career challenges when she is told that her father is dead. The message does not seem to affect her much, and she hesitantly travels back to the kingdom of her childhood on Hvaler to go to the funeral and meet the family she has hardly seen in the last ten years.
title: Hvaler

overview: Bill Bailey hosts the fast-paced quiz show that pits two teams of comedians against each other, to find out once and for all who's best - Kiwis or Aussies.
title: Patriot Brains

overview: Natural history series focusing on the spectacular scenery and indigenous wildlife of Russia. The team undertakes a nine month venture to capture the length and breadth of the largest country on Earth from a birds eye view with the best aerial cameras in the world including locations granted film permits for the very first time in cinematic history.
title: Russia from Above

overview: Den unge Fleksnes is an Advent calendar for TV, which will be broadcast on TVNorge Christmas 2010. The series is about the character Marve Fleksnes, known from the Norwegian comedy series Fleksnes fatalities, as a 13-year-old.
title: Den unge Fleksnes

overview: Popstokk is synonymous with Friday night, good music, nice guests, laughter and great atmosphere! Host Erik Solbakken kicks off the weekend with a music competition where the whole family can participate.
title: Popstokk

overview: Wipeout is an American TV concept, and this Norwegian version is a co-production with Sweden and Denmark. Norwegians, Swedes and Danes compete for the prize of NOK 50,000. The host of the Norwegian broadcast is Synnøve Skarbø, with the two comedians Anders Hoff and Øyvind Rafto from Raske Menn as commentators.
title: Wipeout

overview: Landeplage is a documentary series with Ivar "Ravi" Johansen. The program deals with well-known Norwegian pop and rock songs that had maintained their popularity for many years. Among other things, the program tried to investigate why this particular one became such a big hit.
title: Landeplage

overview: A popular science entertainment program with a permanent panel of experts. The comedy duo Dagfinn Lyngbø and Anne-Kat. Hærland asks the questions they have always wanted answered. These are the small questions about the big topics.
title: Lyngbø og Hærlands Big Bang

overview: Den siste viking is a magnificent and highly expensive reality series where 18 Norwegians are sent a thousand years back in time to measure knowledge and strength. The one with the highest Viking percentage in the blood remains the winner. Host Trond Espen Seim leads the reality game in character, as a good - the one who speaks for the Gods. The participants do not know what they are going for, but quickly realize that this will be much tougher than expected.
title: Den siste viking

overview: A four-part docuseries that tells the little-known true story of Beulah Mae Donald, a Black mother in Alabama, who took down the Ku Klux Klan after the brutal murder and lynching of her son, Michael Donald. He was just nineteen years old when he was found dead, hanging from a tree in Mobile, on March 21, 1981. The local Black community immediately suspected it was a Klan lynching, but local law enforcement was slow to acknowledge that the murder was racially motivated. Beulah Mae and local Black leaders refused to back down until Michael's killers and the hateful organization they belonged to were brought to justice.
title: The People V. The Klan

overview: Four couples move into identical and dilapidated apartments in a four-person home in Oslo. Love is put to the test when they renovate the apartment room by room, and make gold out of gray stone. The couples get 350,000 kroner and ten weeks at their disposal on the way to the big goal: to sell the apartment at an auction.
title: Grottenveien 1

overview: In Hellstrøms Mesterkokk, 14 men and women who already work in restaurant kitchens will meet in a tough competition. Chefs in the Norwegian elite, chefs with experience from the world's best restaurants and young, brilliant culinary talents are given tasks in food and cooking, and they must perform their very best to advance in the competition. The competitors travel to Western Norway and Northern Norway to work with the best raw materials. Master chef Eyvind Hellstrøm will in each program select one who must leave the competition, and in the end he chooses "his" new chef. The winner of Hellstrøm's master chef receives NOK 250,000, as well as a paid study stay at two of New York's foremost restaurants, "Daniel" and "Per Se". Both restaurants have three stars in the Michelin guide.
title: Hellstrøms Mesterkokk

overview: Tore Sagen, Bjarte Tjøstheim and Steinar Sagen's light-hearted entertainment program with sketches, discussion, debate and the occasional guest. Why should you watch the Radio Reception on TV, you ask. Well, why do you actually watch TV? To make time go by.
title: Radioresepsjonen på TV

overview: 18 young girls and boys will compete for the opportunity to realize their bartender dream. On the Greek island of Kos is the European Bartender School, where hungry and ambitious young people can get help on the way to the goal of making a good living from the bartending profession. Through four weeks of intense training, teaching and practice, the participants will fight to become the litter's best bartender. At the Bartender School, the students live close to each other for a longer period, and in the series we also follow the participants after the school day is over. With it, the viewers also get an insight into an extravagant culture, where fleeting connections and strong bonds of friendship come and go among young people who want to take in all that life has to offer. However, the competitive element in the series gets the final word, and tough challenges behind the bar give participants the opportunity to show that they have a bartender star in them. Anyone who does not keep the required level falls through, and the strict judges put the list high.
title: Bartenderskolen

overview: Based on the American version, Roast fra Chat Noir will see celebrities roast each other.
title: Roast fra Chat Noir

overview: Series about the United States.
title: Amerika utenfor allfarveg

overview: 11 boys and girls aged 15-17 arrive at Helgelandsmoen where they will live and compete in the coming weeks. They will fight to be named Norway's greatest goalkeeper talent. The winner gets a stay at Liverpool FC. Frode Grodås and Stig Inge Bjørnebye are coaches and put the young people to hard tests.
title: Nummer 1

overview: Winter is something most Norwegians are familiar with, but does the average Norwegian manage to survive outside in the winter? . In Robinsonekspedisjonen vinter, we have sent a group of Norwegians to to a deserted Pacific island to see how they cope with the freezing cold.
title: Robinsonekspedisjonen vinter

overview: Jo Røislien sees reality in a special way. He is, basically, a mathematician who sees everything around him by mathematicians glasses. Mathematics can make the world easier to understand. How can this be possible? Can figures have such significance for humans?
title: Siffer

overview: Amigo, a game show for you who want something more! With tough participants, even tougher challenges and great prizes.
title: Amigo

overview: Game show for the whole family. Three generations. Two families. One southern trip.
title: Amigo Grande

overview: 14 participants travel back in time to experience different eras in Norwegian history. They will work their way up from poverty and toil to wealth and honor. But only one can run away with the victory and the citizens' letter.
title: Anno

overview: The series is a social experiment whose purpose is to get Norwegian youth to appreciate their voting rights, and use it in this year's municipal elections. We meet eight people with completely different backgrounds. Isolated in an unfamiliar place, they must live in a dictatorship with strict rations and curfews, without access to natural light, and with unpredictable orders from an invisible regime. During the coming days, participants get really feel on your body what it is like to be deprived of rights and benefits which they might otherwise take for granted.
title: Diktaturet

overview: Ordinary Norwegians can challenge the Ylvis brothers in a number of varied and challenging competitions. The prize is up to one million kroner.
title: Hvem kan slå Ylvis?

overview: ER explores the inner workings of an urban teaching hospital and the critical issues faced by the dedicated physicians and staff of its overburdened emergency room. The highly acclaimed drama series holds the distinction of being recognized as the most Emmy-nominated series in the history of television.
title: ER

overview: Two presenters help fulfill the dreams of people they thought deserved it. Before that happened, the candidates were tricked with a hidden camera. Friends or family members signed up for those who wanted their dream to come true.
title: Kvelden er din

overview: A series for children about the Sami boy Ante.
title: Ante

overview: Cuts at SAS mean that Captain Odd Grenland and 2nd pilot Birger Wom are fired because they are too old. Grenland buys a used aircraft with his own money, and together they start the company Senior-Air, which will compete with SAS on the Oslo-Bergen route. With them they get the mechanical genius Joar "Jojo" Johansen, Jasmin Rosenrot, former cabin manager in Spantax and the number genius Karl Åge Tørkle.
title: Luftens Helter

overview: For 365 days, experienced hiker Lars Monsen travels alone through the Cap of the North, the wilderness of Northern Scandinavia. We follow the daily events of Monsen's adventure, his interaction with the local people and wildlife, and the changing of the seasons.
title: Nordkalotten 365

overview: Program about collectibles, antiques, old dishes and displays from bygone times.
title: Antikviteter og snurrepiperier

overview: Timothy Dahle, best known as the manager of Boyzvoice, and former participant of Nissene På Låven, has had his own talk show on TV.
title: Tonight med Timothy Dahle

overview: Thomas Numme, Harald Rønneberg and two other friends send Truls Svendsen on a number of fun assignments along the Norwegian coast in Truls - Oppdrag Hurtigruten. Before Truls can board the Hurtigruten in Bergen, he must go through a hefty safety course which, among other things, involves a drop of thirty meters with a lifeboat. The trip later goes to Florø where he learns beer brewing at Kinn Brewery and to Stadt where surfing puts Truls' physics to the test. On Måløy there will be spectacular nature experiences, and on Herøy Truls will be commissioned to play the main role in a historical game.
title: Truls - Oppdrag Hurtigruten

overview: For half a year, TV 2's team has followed everyday life at the Aquarium in Bergen, and the result has been a documentary series in six parts packed with drama, cute penguins, dangerous reptiles, fish, harnesses and enthusiastic animal keepers.
title: Akvariet

overview: Bård Tufte Johansen and Harald Eia sum up the past year, and with them they have an elite team of Norwegian comedians. Harald Eia is the host and a rolling panel will every week try to remember what was important news in 2014.
title: Årsrevyen med Harald Eia

overview: Eyvind Hellstrøm takes the dog and good friends to Gol to enjoy the pre-Christmas period. Viewers are also invited to see how the master chef celebrates the holiday, and not least how he prepares Christmas food. There are still one or two restaurant managers in this country who hardly dream of celebrating Christmas with the Bagatelle manager. After a hectic and hectic clean-up tour all over the country, we have become better acquainted with the adult perfectionist Hellstrøm. But at the cabin among friends, he shows other sides of himself. Eyvind Hellstrøm counts down the days until Christmas Eve.
title: Jul med Hellstrøm

overview: Janne breaks up with her boyfriend Pontus, because living with him isn't the romantic fairytale she expected from a relationship. But life without him might not be exactly perfect either.
title: Schmokk

overview: One of NSB's passenger trains is on the way from Oslo to Bergen. Aboard the train are two investigators on the way home and on vacation. Suddenly the train is buried by an avalanche in Finse, and when the power comes back, they discover that two passengers have been murdered.
title: Toget - På sporet av en morder

overview: Factual series on Norwegian history for the Constitution Anniversary. What is Norwegian and what makes us Norwegians? And where did the original constitution from Eidsvoll go? Haddy N'jie and Swede Per Sinding-Larsen are hunting for the Norwegian and his constitution.
title: Jakten på Norge 1814-2014

overview: Torsdagsklubben is a satirical comedy program. The program is led by Silje Stang, with Otto Jespersen and Thomas Giertsen as regular panelists. In addition, two guests appear in each show.
title: Torsdagsklubben

overview: Forensic Factor presents the world's best CSI's armed with the latest investigative tools in the hunt to catch elusive criminals. Each episode explores one baffling case, revealing the amazing science being used by North America's top crime fighters.
title: F2: Forensic Factor
